description: Acceptance evidence for milestone W-A of docs/whole_space_transition.md: the exact modal transparent (Dirichlet-to-Neumann) outer condition d_r psi_hat_k(R) + [2/R + |k| K_0(|k|R)/K_1(|k|R)] psi_hat_k(R) = 0 applied to the E-25 finite-cylinder elliptic problem. The same compactly supported source family as the E-33 wall-truncation run (support 0.95, exponent 8, core 0.9) is solved on nested cylinders R in {1, 1.5, 2, 3} that share their radial spacing bitwise, under both outer conditions, at three radial resolutions, for one exactly z-independent case and three axial modes spanning kR from 0.196 (algebraic regime) to 6.28 (exponential regime).
interpretation: This measures whether the transparent outer condition removes the artificial-wall truncation error of THIS discretization, leaving only the O(dr^2) discretization error of the boundary row. It is not a continuum bound, it does not make the elliptic problem a whole-space problem in any rigorous sense, and it is not singularity evidence. Its content is narrow: with a compactly supported source, moving the artificial wall stops moving the solution.
physical_wall_warning: The condition measured here belongs to the whole-space problem. The Hou reproduction keeps the PHYSICAL no-slip wall of audit entry E-27, where psi_1(t,1,z)=0 is a boundary condition of the modelled flow and not a truncation artefact. Runs that reproduce Hou must keep boundary_condition='dirichlet'; the transparent path exists only for whole-space exploration and is never selected implicitly.
